svg.title: B09 / EUROPA CHEMGRID — Yellowstone Geochemical Atlas engineering mission profile
svg.desc: B09, EUROPA CHEMGRID — Yellowstone Geochemical Atlas. Original project: Mapping Hot Spring Geochemistry in Yellowstone. Session B: Earth & Environmental Engineering. Scientific question: Can chemical facies and unsampled-feature uncertainty be mapped without smoothing across disconnected hydrothermal plumbing? Testable hypothesis: Basin- and flow-path-aware models should outperform distance-only interpolation near chemical boundaries; some areas may remain unsuitable for prediction.. svg.text: Mapping Hot Spring Geochemistry in Yellowstone
No project observations acquired · specified cases await execution · shared demonstrations are separately labeled
Create a versioned Yellowstone thermal-water atlas preserving sample
identity, dates, methods and uncertainty. This project addresses spatial
mapping and sampling design; CALDERA SENTINEL tests deformation
relationships. Display supported observations and sparse-data regions
explicitly, preventing attractive interpolation from concealing disconnected
hydrothermal systems or incompatible historical assays.
